scriptText:
I. MOSAIC (ANIMATION)

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a stylized animated sequence in a French graphic novel aesthetic featuring @actor1 as MARK (voice: @audio1) and @actor2 as ROBERT (voice: @audio2) in an intellectual walk-and-talk down a 1970s university corridor, debating visual tokenization through exaggerated hand-drawn dynamics.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain a continuous backward tracking shot without cuts. Preserve 180-degree axis discipline, hand-prop continuity for the blue exam folders, and exaggerated squash-and-stretch animation physics throughout the walk.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: French animated cinema aesthetic, Franco-Belgian graphic novel style, contemporary editorial illustration, semi-ligne claire contour inking, muted digital watercolor wash, textured gouache shading, matte surface finish, subtle pigment grain
Palette: Amber ochre, burnt sienna, slate blue, institutional olive, cream
Lighting: Grimy overhead fluorescent flicker mixed with warm late-afternoon clerestory rays
Location: Gothic Revival university hallway, vaulted arches, linoleum tile grid
Wardrobe: Mark wearing an oversized charcoal knit cardigan over a mustard henley, dark tweed trousers; Robert wearing an olive-drab trench coat over a faded denim button-down, charcoal slacks, thick tortoiseshell glasses
Sound: Purely diegetic; linoleum shoe squeaks, radiator clanks, paper rustling, hollow corridor ambience
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MS, EYE-LEVEL, centered. Robert strides forward down the linoleum corridor, clutching blue exam folders to his chest. Gothic archways recede into deep linear perspective behind him.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] MS, tracking backward -> [MOTION] Anticipation crouch into extreme linear stretch -> [ACT] Mark catapults from a recessed doorway into frame -> [ACT] Robert maintains his steady stride without flinching -> <Shoe rubber squeak on linoleum>
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Quick pivot with dynamic secondary hair follow-through -> [ACT] Mark snaps into a backward walk facing Robert -> Mark says with wide eyes {The grid's a lie, Robert!} -> [ACT] Mark flings both hands upward in disbelief
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Floating ease-in on backward stride -> [ACT] Mark spreads his fingers wide to outline an invisible box -> Mark says (urgent whisper) {Pixels aren't atoms. The model stopped seeing particles.} -> [ACT] Mark points an accusatory finger toward Robert's chest
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Subtle shoulder bounce and rhythmic weight shift -> [ACT] Robert tightens his grip on the exam folders -> Robert says with a dry smirk {I assume you stayed up reading the new paper. Good morning, Mark.} -> [ACT] Robert tilts his head in weary amusement
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Snappy exaggeration with hand smear frames -> [ACT] Mark shakes his head while miming a cutting motion -> Mark says (sharp cadence) {It's a shift! Shattering images into sixteen-by-sixteen patches.} -> [ACT] Mark pulls an invisible string between his hands -> <Paper folder creak>
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Arc trajectory drift shifting Mark from front to screen-left flank -> [ACT] Mark rotates mid-stride to walk parallel beside Robert -> [ACT] Mark chops the air into rigid grid squares -> Mark says {Discrete tokens.} -> Mark drops his arms with a sharp exhale
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Subtle squash on footsteps with synchronized head turn -> [ACT] Robert glances sideways over his spectacles -> [ACT] Robert adjusts the folders against his ribcage -> Robert says (thoughtful cadence) {So, it’s a mosaic? Tiles that suggest a face.} -> Robert nods slightly
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Exaggerated upward pop on step -> [ACT] Mark snaps his fingers with intense joy -> Mark says (beaming) {Exactly! Geometry masquerading as language.} -> [ACT] Mark traces a rapid geometric spiral in mid-air -> <Crisp finger snap>
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Follow-through flutter on exam folder edges -> [ACT] Robert looks down at the blue booklets -> [ACT] Robert flicks the paper corners with his thumb -> Robert says with a low chuckle {I hope it can tokenize these essays into something coherent.} -> <Rapid paper fluttering>
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Sudden recoil with comedic head tilt -> [ACT] Mark taps his temple rhythmically with one finger -> Mark says (grinning) {Only if the weights are balanced, Rob.} -> [ACT] Mark leans forward into his stride
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Progressive silhouette stretch into high-contrast chiaroscuro -> [ACT] Mark matches Robert's deliberate tempo -> [ACT] Robert lets out a soft, amused breath -> <Distant radiator pipe hiss>
[CAM 01] -> [MOTION] Slow ease-out decrescendo into deep archway shadow -> [ACT] Mark and Robert stride shoulder-to-shoulder into the vaulted darkness -> [ACT] Robert shifts his papers firmly under his arm -> <Fading hollow footsteps>
[</BRIEF>]
